The app currently runs in local demo mode. Firebase account authorization is still required.

  1. Restore access to Firebase and sign in.
  2. Create a project and select the database region.
  3. Connect Authentication and deploy a transactional booking backend with tenant access rules.
  4. Verify concurrent bookings and permissions in Firebase emulators before switching to live mode.

Local bookings are not synchronized across devices. This preview does not provide real customer authentication, multi-business isolation, or notifications.
